description: Side-by-side records of 2 to 4 games (same fields as get_game): players and growth, momentum, reviews, age, revenue estimate range and complaints. Momentum is comparable across platforms; raw players (Roblox, Fortnite peak per hour) and reviews (Steam) are not. Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.
